title: Audit: crypto2dev 2026-04-19
notes: Confidence: FIPS gate coverage: 99% — every callback in every provider was inspected individually by the subagent; zero violations found. The only unverified risk is a future caller of wolfssl_ec_key.c internal helpers without gating (the helpers themselves are not gated; callers must gate). Key material leak risk: 5% — memzero_explicit is consistent throughout; the ikm_buf double-free (WOLFKM-76h.1) hits freed memory but does not expose key material to userspace. UAPI stability: 98% — all structs verified for padding, all reserved fields validated, all slot tombstones handled. Gaps: (1) could not run lockdep to verify no sleeping-in-atomic paths missed at runtime; (2) could not run KASAN to confirm the ikm_buf double-free trigger independently; (3) kcapi GCM 12-byte tag bug (WOLFKM-76h.2) was found by static analysis but not confirmed with a live test run. Would raise confidence if: kernel lockdep run on the test suite, KASAN/KFENCE enabled test run, and a CMVP lab review of the FIPS gate two-level architecture (framework + per-callback defense-in-depth).
